Subject: Fraudulent Payment through fake cheques- reg.

Sir,
Please refer to your letter No. SME/L&TP/91 dated 30.08.2013 on the
above said subject.

2. In this connection, it is stated that instructions are already in place vide this
office letter No. Bkg/Fraud/05/15610-15613 dated 24.11.11 for our field office as well as
SBI that “all payment to the beneficiaries from A/c No. I, X and XXI be made through
NEFT unless in a case where the beneficiaries who have their Bank account in a bank
where payment through NEFT is not possible, payment may be made through cheques
with following monetary limits:

From A/c No. I upto Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lac only)
From A/c No. X upto Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousands only)
From A/c No. XXI_ upto Rs.1,30,000/- (Rupees One lac thirty thousands only)

Under no circumstances, cheques beyond above limit be issued/honoured by bank
form A/c No. I,X and XXI effective from 01.12.2011 onwards.

3. Regarding affixing stamp on the cheques leaves issued by EPFO, it is stated
that first of all it is not practically possible as it require manual intervention in affixing
the stamps. Secondly, our bank accounts (I/X/XXI) are opened with link branches with
separate account numbers for each EPF Account at our different Offices. Hence, the
prescribed limit for each account should be linked with its account number by each
branch individually.

Page 1 of 2

4. The list of bank account number of A/c Nos. I/X/XXI of each of the 120
EPF offices is therefore being enclosed herewith. SBI may issue instructions to each link
branch to fix the monetary limit individually with each bank account with them.

Yours faithfully,
Encls. As above.

~ Sd.
(S.K. Singh)
Regional PF Commissioner-II
(Finance Division)

Copy to information and necessary action to:
1. All Addl. CPFC(Zones)

2. All RPFCs/In-charge of Regional & Sub-Regional Offices to ensure that their
link branch has fixed the monetary limit of Rs.1,00,000/- in respect of A/c No.
I, Rs.50,000/- in r/o A/c No. X, and Rs.1,30,000/- in r/o A/c No. XXI for the
purpose of payment through cheque only in the cases where payment through
NEFT is not possible. The payment beyond the prescribed monetary limit (if
not possible through NEFT) is to be made through demand draft/bankers’
cheques which will be issued by the link branches free of cost.

3. DD(OL), Headquarters for Hindi version.

Regional PF Commissione
(Finance Division)
